known_limits: Creator Covenant legal language remains draft_for_counsel_review
production-grade identity proof beyond authenticated account is not yet claimed
cryptographically signed disclosure receipts are not yet wired into the Base44 UI
protected asset upload/reveal is intentionally not exposed in the public listing flow
fingerprint registration is evidence support and is not represented as copyright registration, patent filing, or dispositive proof of ownership
public deployment URL is not yet claimed
Mutual immutable-snapshot approval and disclosure-grant acceptance are technical evidence/consent controls, not signed legal agreements and not authorization for actual protected-file delivery
Multi-party assembly is verified in the private Base44 runtime but the public transactional UI is still not claimed deployed
Current multi-party work packages coordinate scope, economics, dependencies and progress but do not execute payment, escrow, legal signature or protected-file delivery
An accepted team invitation or work package is operational assent only and does not itself grant intellectual-property rights or create a final legal agreement
Execution blueprints are heuristic recommendations from safe metadata and are not proof that a candidate is qualified, available, willing or suitable
Blueprint candidate suggestions do not establish membership, partnership, contract, IP rights or authorization; every candidate still requires the normal protected connection and team gates
Sourcing availability and quote responses are participant-supplied commercial signals and are not independently verified by the platform
A firm quote label in sourcing is still not payment, contract execution, purchase order, escrow or acceptance of the downstream work package

Sourcing decision scores are transparent heuristics for comparing current evidence and are not proof that a higher-scoring partner is better, safer, more qualified, more reliable or the correct choice
Observed Fabric history currently reflects accepted work-package records and current terminal/progress state; it is not an external reputation score or comprehensive performance history
Prices in different currencies are not normalized by FX in v1.4 and are only price-compared against responses in the same currency
Geography uses declared profile/opportunity location strings and remote-work policy rather than route-time, distance or logistics-cost optimization
release_rule: Do not claim protected-asset disclosure, final legal enforceability, public deployment, or production payment until separately verified.
